In absence of bilingual stenography candidates, English Stenography candidates may be considered eligible
salary: Selected candidates will be placed on the 7th CPC Pay Level applicable to their post, along with other admissible allowances. The pay structure for each post is given below.
age_limit: For all posts mentioned in this recruitment, candidates must have attained the age of 18 years and must not have attained the age of 40 years as on the last date of submission of the online application. || SC/ST/OBC and other specified categories of Uttar Pradesh: upper age relaxation as specified by the Government, maximum up to 5 years as per relevant Government Orders || Permanent government employees with at least 3 years of regular and continuous service in the relevant field: relaxation up to 5 years || Physically handicapped candidates (General category): up to 5 years for Group-B posts and 10 years for Group-C posts || Physically handicapped candidates (OBC/SC/ST): up to 10 years for Group-B posts and 15 years for Group-C posts || Ex-servicemen and dependents of Freedom Fighters: relaxation as per Government of India rules || This age relaxation is admissible only to candidates who are domicile of Uttar Pradesh; candidates from other states are eligible to apply only against Unreserved (UR) vacancies
application_fee: Candidates need to pay a non-refundable application fee online as per their category. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and separate fee for each post. || Candidates covered under horizontal (other category) reservation must pay the fee applicable to their own original category. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances.
selection_process: Selection will be made through a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), conducted bilingually in Hindi and English. || Screening Examination:Qualifying in nature, held only to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks from this stage are not carried forward, and only 10 times the number of advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted for the Main Exam || Main Examination:Final selection is based solely on marks obtained in this exam, prepared category-wise based on merit and reservation norms || Exam Pattern:Both Screening and Mains exams carry 100 marks each, of 2 hours' duration, consisting only of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) — 60 marks on the subject related to the post, 10 marks each on General English, General Knowledge, Reasoning, and Mathematical Aptitude || Negative Marking:1 mark is awarded for each correct answer; 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer || Qualifying Marks:50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates; 40% for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates || Skill Test:Conducted after the Main Exam for the Stenographer post (Stenography/Typing Test in English or Hindi, Mangal or Krutidev 10 font). Candidates equal to five times the advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted; the Skill Test is qualifying in nature and its marks are not counted in the final merit
